messages:
support_jen: Customer (ACME) reports that when they invoke two tools in parallel (kb_search + web_summarizer) the tool_results are intermittently mapped to the wrong tool. e.g. summary text attached to a different search hit.

ops-bot: runtime:INFO req=1988881234 correlation=cr-7890 tool_map: returned_indices=[0,1] mapping_observed=[1,0]

eng_julio: can you paste the exact request payload + runtime response? i need request_id, per-tool call_index, and tool names.

support_jen: pasted minimal payload from ACME (they call two tools in one API call). they also noted they use our SDK v1.4 which sets a client-level call_id unless overridden. payload:
```json
{
  "request_id":"ri-01a2b3c4",
  "tools":[
    { "name":"kb_search", "args": { "query":"pricing for bulk inference", "call_id":"session-42" } },
    { "name":"web_summarizer", "args": { "url":"https://acme.example/price-list.html", "call_id":"session-42" } }
  ]
}
```
They said 12/50 runs produced swapped mapping.

devx-lin: that client call_id reuse is a red flag but runtime mustn't rely on client arg values for mapping. server should tag each tool invocation with an internal invocation_id. i pulled the runtime trace — looks like the tool_result mapping key is only using request_id, so concurrent tool_results race and last-writer wins.

sre_nora: pasted runtime excerpt:
```
[2026-03-17T14:01:12Z] req=ri-01a2b3c4 START parallel tools=2
[2026-03-17T14:01:12Z] req=ri-01a2b3c4 tool_exec kb_search -> invocation_tag=inv-7a
[2026-03-17T14:01:12Z] req=ri-01a2b3c4 tool_exec web_summarizer -> invocation_tag=inv-7b
[2026-03-17T14:01:12Z] tool_result for inv-7b saved to map[ri-01a2b3c4] = result_obj (overwrites existing)
[2026-03-17T14:01:12Z] tool_result for inv-7a saved to map[ri-01a2b3c4] = result_obj (overwrites existing)
[2026-03-17T14:01:12Z] RESPOND req=ri-01a2b3c4 tool_results: [ result_obj ]  // collapsed/misordered
```

eng_julio: confirmed — bug is that the map uses request_id as the unique key instead of a composite (request_id + invocation_tag or tool_index). also possible interaction with schema validation: if a tool returns a validation error we short-circuit result insertion and reuse a slot. please repro locally: run the attached harness with concurrency=2 and repeat 100 times. i'll try now.

support_jen: ACME provided a repro curl they ran:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/run -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"request_id":"ri-01a2b3c4","tools":[{"name":"kb_search","args":{"query":"bulk pricing","call_id":"session-42"}},{"name":"web_summarizer","args":{"url":"https://acme.example/price-list.html","call_id":"session-42"}}]}'
```
They say with that exact payload they got wrong mapping ~24% of runs in eu-west-1.

devx-lin: short-term mitigation: advise customers to set unique per-tool call_id (workaround), or set SDK option sequential_tools=true to force ordered execution. i'll open a runtime patch to change map key to `${request_id}:${invocation_tag}` and add assertion test.

eng_julio: assigning to eng-runtime (p1 for Dedicated customer). i'll own the PR and tests. tasks:
- add composite key mapping tests (concurrency stress)
- ensure schema validation failures don't reuse slots
- add telemetry to detect any further misassoc errors

sre_nora: i'll canary the change in eu-west-1-dev slot once PR merges. no billing impact, high user impact (incorrect outputs).

support_jen: i'll reply to ACME with repro steps + temporary workaround (unique call_id or sequential_tools). also sending apology + offer to run their workload on a dev cluster.

eng_julio: noted. i'll update this thread when PR is open and when canary looks good. thanks all. :thumbsup:
